I re-took screenshots of the 1:1, 4:5 and 16:9 artboards after the last edit, and they look the same as before. The story fix didn't touch them. The dark box at the bottom right of the 16:9 screenshot is the studio's own toolbar, not part of the design.

All four formats of **`ui/2026/combine/Combine-oznameni.tsx`** have now been screenshotted and checked after the final edit. The summary in my previous message still holds, including the two things to decide:

- **The date has passed:** the combine on 7. 10. 2026 was three weeks ago.
- **No photos:** the set is type and texture only.
